content.text:
The review bot left 3 findings on #412. I checked each one against the source.

```a2ui
surface("review", sendDataModel=true)
$/f1 = ["fix"]
$/f2 = ["fix"]
$/f3 = ["dismiss"]
$/r2 = ""
$/r3 = "keptCards is capped at 100 entries."
h1 = Stack([File("apps/web/src/components/chat/A2uiSurface.tsx"), Badge("Real bug", tone="error")], direction="horizontal", gap="small", justify="between")
d1 = Diff("""@@ -91,2 +91,3 @@
   const onAction = useStableCallback((action) => {
+    if (state.sent) return;
     setCardSent(state, true);""", path="")
c1 = Choice([{label: "Fix", value: "fix"}, {label: "Dismiss", value: "dismiss"}], $/f1)
row1 = Stack([h1, Text("A double click sends the action twice."), d1, c1], gap="small")
h2 = Stack([File("apps/web/src/components/chat/a2uiCanvas.ts"), Badge("Likely real", tone="warning")], direction="horizontal", gap="small", justify="between")
d2 = Diff("""@@ -88,1 +88,1 @@
-    return this.surface(surfaceId)?.dataModel.get("/");
+    return this.surface(surfaceId)?.dataModel.get("/") ?? {};""", path="")
c2 = Choice([{label: "Fix", value: "fix"}, {label: "Dismiss", value: "dismiss"}], $/f2)
n2 = Field("Reply if dismissed", $/r2, placeholder="Why this is not a bug")
row2 = Stack([h2, Text("dataModel() can return undefined after a surface is deleted."), d2, c2, n2], gap="small")
h3 = Stack([File("apps/web/src/components/chat/A2uiSurface.tsx"), Badge("False positive", tone="neutral")], direction="horizontal", gap="small", justify="between")
c3 = Choice([{label: "Fix", value: "fix"}, {label: "Dismiss", value: "dismiss"}], $/f3)
n3 = Field("Reply if dismissed", $/r3)
row3 = Stack([h3, Text("keptCards grows without bound."), c3, n3], gap="small")
actions = Button("Apply decisions", Event("apply"), tone="primary")
root = Panel([row1, row2, row3, actions], title="Review findings on #412", description="3 from the review bot. My call on each; change any before I act.")
```

Done. I fixed the double send and posted your replies on the other two.

```a2ui
surface("review", update=true)
c1 = Badge("Fixed in 9d1e2b4", tone="success")
c2 = Badge("Dismissed, reply posted", tone="neutral")
n2 = Text("Replied: covered by the null check two lines up.", variant="muted")
c3 = Badge("Dismissed, reply posted", tone="neutral")
n3 = Text("Replied: keptCards is capped at 100 entries.", variant="muted")
actions = Alert("Pushed 9d1e2b4 to #412", description="1 fix, 2 replies. Review checks are running.", tone="success")
```
